info.title: QA.tech API
info.description: REST API for triggering and managing AI-powered test runs. Authenticate with a project API token (Authorization: Bearer <token>) found in Project Settings -> Integrations.

get.description: List all applications for the project

post.description: Create an application build record from a previously uploaded file. Use buildShortId in run API with environment.applicationBuildShortId.
Get a presigned URL to upload a build file directly to storage

get.description: List environments for a specific application
Get a sample status badge as SVG (no token). For live project badges use GET /v1/badge.svg.
Get status badge as SVG. Authenticate with the token query parameter (not the API Bearer key). Project is resolved from the token.

post.description:
Create a new chat conversation and send its first message.

Returns 202 immediately with the created conversation. Processing is asynchronous: poll
`GET /chat/{chatConversationShortId}` until the latest assistant message has
`status: 'COMPLETED'` to read the reply.

202.description: The request has been accepted for processing, but processing has not yet completed.

post.description: Create a new chat conversation and start an autonomous change review from either a PR URL or raw change input.

202.description: The request has been accepted for processing, but processing has not yet completed.

post.description:
Send a chat message to an existing conversation.

Returns 202 immediately. Poll `GET /chat/{chatConversationShortId}` until the latest
assistant message has `status: 'COMPLETED'` to read the reply.

202.description: The request has been accepted for processing, but processing has not yet completed.

get.description:
Get conversation metadata and recent messages (newest first).

Use `limit` to control how many messages are returned (default 20). To detect when an
assistant reply is finished, poll until the most recent `assistant` message has
`status: 'COMPLETED'` (or `CANCELLED`/`FAILED`).

post.description: Create a new remote tunnel that exposes local ports via Cloudflare. Returns a tunnelToken to start the cloudflared daemon.

get.description: List remote tunnels for the authenticated project

delete.description: Tear down a remote tunnel and its DNS records

get.description: Get the live Cloudflare health status of a remote tunnel

post.description: Execute a run for a given project. Supports API or GITHUB trigger. When using GITHUB trigger, provide actor, branch, commitHash, commitMessage, and repository. Use applications to override environment or device preset per run.

get.description: Get a run by shortId with test cases

post.description: Rerun a specific run with optional filters
Create a new test case for a project

get.description: List test cases for a project

ApplicationBuildCreateRequest.description: Request body for creating an application build after uploading via presigned URL

ApplicationBuildCreateResponse.description: Response with created application build metadata. Use buildShortId in run API environment override.

fileName.description: Original file name (e.g. 'my-app.apk'). Preserved in storage for display and file type detection.

ApplicationBuildUploadUrlRequest.description: Request body for getting a presigned upload URL

ApplicationEnvironmentOverrideByApplicat.description: Use a specific application build (from POST /v1/application/builds). Creates or reuses an environment with this build.

ApplicationOverride.description: Override application, environment, or device preset for a specific run

ApplicationOverrideWithRequiredEnvironme.description: Application override with a required environment

showDate.description: When true, show relative time since last run.

BadgeExampleSvgQuery.description: Query parameters for GET /v1/badge-example.svg (deterministic sample badges for docs and demos; no project token).

showDate.description: When true, show relative time since last run.

testPlanShortId.description: Filter runs to this test plan (short id, e.g. pln_my-plan_shortid). Required with `token`.

createdBy.description: Filter by user id who created the run.

trigger.description: Filter runs by how they were triggered.

BadgeSvgQuery.description: Query parameters for GET /v1/badge.svg (live status badge). Token identifies the project; do not use Bearer auth for this operation.

ChangeReviewRawChanges.description: Structured raw change data for change review mode

source.description: Where the conversation originated. `api` for conversations created via this API, `ui` for the dashboard, `github`/`gitlab` for VCS-triggered chats, and `system` for everything else.

messages.description: Recent messages, newest first. Empty on creation; poll `GET /chat/{chatConversationShortId}` to retrieve.

ChatConversationResponse.description: Conversation data with recent messages (newest first).

text.description: The plain-text body of the message.

status.description: Lifecycle status of the message. Poll until `COMPLETED` to know the assistant has finished.

isStreaming.description: True while the assistant is still streaming tokens for this message.

ChatMessageItem.description: A chat message. Tool calls and reasoning are not exposed in this version; only the text response is returned.

message.description: The message text to send. Example: 'Generate a login flow test for staging'.

applicationOverrides.description: Optional per-application environment overrides to apply for this conversation.

ChatRequest.description: Request body for sending a chat message

ports.description: One or more local ports to expose via the tunnel

public.description: If true, the tunnel is publicly accessible without Cloudflare Access authentication

CreateRemoteTunnelRequest.description: Request body to create a new remote tunnel

runnerId.description: Our identifier for this runner, used in subsequent API calls

hostnames.description: Public hostnames mapped to local ports

tunnelToken.description: cloudflared token to start the tunnel daemon

expiresAt.description: ISO timestamp when this tunnel will expire

CreateRemoteTunnelResponse.description: Response after successfully creating a remote tunnel

CreateTestCaseRequest.description: Request body for creating a new test case linked to a project

DeleteRemoteTunnelResponse.description: Response after deleting a remote tunnel

localPort.description: The local port this hostname maps to

url.description: The public HTTPS URL for this port

HostnameInfo.description: A single hostname mapping returned by the tunnel

ListRemoteTunnelsResponse.description: Response for listing active remote tunnels

NotificationOverride.description: Override notifications for a specific run

protocol.description: Protocol for the local service (defaults to http)

subdomain.description: Optional subdomain label for this port (e.g. 'api' -> r-{id}-api.quack.run)

PortMappingRequest.description: A single port mapping to expose through the tunnel

status.description: inactive = no connections, degraded = 1-3 connections, healthy = 4+ connections

connections.description: Number of active Cloudflare edge connections

RemoteTunnelStatusResponse.description: Live health status of a remote tunnel from Cloudflare

isExpired.description: Whether the tunnel is expired (expires_at is in the past)

RemoteTunnelSummary.description: Summary of an active remote tunnel

RerunRequest.description: Request body to rerun prior run.

RunRequest.description: Request body for triggering a test run. Supports GitHub trigger fields and application overrides.

StartChangeReviewFromPrRequest.description: Start a change review chat using a pull request URL

StartChangeReviewFromRawChangesRequest.description: Start a change review chat using raw change data

StartChangeReviewRequest.description: Request body for starting a change review chat

StatusBadgeExampleName.description: Named presets for GET /v1/badge-example.svg (deterministic sample SVGs).

StatusBadgeStyle.description: Display style of the status badge.

StatusBadgeTriggerFilter.description: Permitted values for filtering a status badge by run trigger. Omit the parameter to include all triggers; use ANY for the same behavior explicitly.

VcsProviderId.description: Supported VCS providers for pull request URL review mode
